supporting_observations.claim: At 13:42:42 UTC, eli.brooks had a successful type-2 interactive logon on WS-EBROOKS-01.
The provided evidence contains one failed type-2 interactive logon for eli.brooks at 13:44:02 UTC on WS-EBROOKS-01; its substatus indicates an incorrect password.

After the successful logon, the workstation recorded standard user-session startup and browser activity, including access to Zoom and Microsoft 365; this context does not establish who caused the failed attempt or why.

known_telemetry_limitations: Winsec and Sysmon logs for DC-BLU-01 and FILE-BLU-01 were not collected during 13:20–14:20 UTC because of a log collection outage.
The supplied evidence includes only one failed logon event for eli.brooks; the missing domain-controller telemetry prevents verifying whether the alert's reported repeated domain logons occurred.
claims_not_established: Whether additional failed logons for eli.brooks occurred on the domain controller or other hosts during the review window.
Whether the failed attempt was a user mistake, a stale credential, or activity by another party.

additional_evidence_needed: Recover or obtain DC-BLU-01 authentication logs for 13:20–14:20 UTC, including failure counts, timestamps, source workstation or address, and logon type.
Correlate authentication events for eli.brooks across other hosts and identity systems during the window.
Confirm with eli.brooks whether they made an incorrect-password attempt around 13:44 UTC.
unrelated_findings: Google Drive is not an approved storage service in the supplied inventory; Google Drive File Stream launched under eli.brooks and the browser accessed drive.google.com. Track separately; this does not establish that the alerted failed logon was malicious. (T191-00016, T191-00103, T191-00104)

GlobalProtect's PanGPA process launched under eli.brooks, although the environment context says there is no VPN. The process launch alone does not establish a VPN connection; track separately from this alert. (T191-00070, T191-00071, T191-00072)
